name: Remodeling Live Transfers

hero.headline: Remodeling Live Transfers
hero.subheadline: Connect with high-intent consumers actively looking for remodeling solutions.

overview: Remodeling Live Transfers are consumers qualified by our team and warm-transferred to your agents, generated by Altarious Global performance campaigns and delivered to your business in real time. Connect homeowners planning kitchen, bathroom and whole-home remodels with remodeling contractors and design-build firms.

Live Transfers protect remodelers from unqualified consultations, which are costly given the time designers and estimators invest. Our team confirms homeownership, property location, project type, budget range, timeline and decision-maker availability before warm-transferring the homeowner to the contractor. This pre-screen removes renters, small repair requests, projects below the contractor's minimum and homeowners with unrealistic budgets, so the sales team meets only with homeowners who can commit to a project of appropriate scale. Transfers can be segmented by project category to route bath, kitchen and addition inquiries to the right specialists.

This product is suited to home services businesses with a team ready to answer during defined hours, a clear view of the consumer they want, and the capacity to convert a live conversation. The acquisition objective is simple: put your team in front of remodeling consumers at the moment they are deciding.
targetConsumer: Owners of single-family homes with significant equity or financing capacity, typically aged 35 to 70, planning a defined remodeling project. The most valuable segments are homeowners with realistic budgets for full kitchen or bathroom remodels, those planning additions or basement conversions, and older homeowners investing in accessibility modifications to remain in their homes.
consumerIntent: Typical intent signals include: searching for kitchen remodel cost, bathroom remodeling near me or remodeling contractors; recently purchased an older home needing updates; family growth or multigenerational living requiring more space; planning to age in place and needs a walk-in shower or accessible layout.
howGenerated: Consumers are acquired through performance campaigns targeting searches such as "kitchen remodel cost" and "bathroom remodeling near me", plus social and comparison placements. Interested consumers speak with our qualification team before any transfer is attempted.
qualification: Qualification is configured to your appetite. Standard remodeling criteria include: owns a single-family home within the contractor's service area; project type identified as kitchen, bathroom, basement, addition or whole-home; budget range stated and above the contractor's minimum project size; timeline for starting the project within the contractor's booking horizon; homeowner and co-decision maker available for a design consultation; not already under contract with another remodeler for the project.
delivery: Once qualified, the consumer is bridged directly to your designated number or queue with a warm introduction. Delivery runs only during your operating hours with daily caps, and you can pause or adjust criteria at any time.

faq.q: Do you qualify homeowners on budget?
faq.a: Yes. Screening captures the homeowner's budget range and applies a minimum threshold aligned with your typical project size, so consultations are focused on viable projects.

faq.q: Can programs focus on bathroom or kitchen projects only?
faq.a: Campaigns and screening can be dedicated to bathrooms, kitchens, basements, additions or whole-home renovations, matching the services you specialise in.

faq.q: How do you handle long project timelines?
faq.a: Timeline is captured during screening and you can set the window you accept, for example projects starting within the next six months, with longer-horizon inquiries excluded or flagged.
